name: bind_repo
description: Bind this workstream to a git repository and check out an isolated worktree for it. Every shell command and file tool in this workstream then runs inside that checkout. Call this before dispatch_agent. With no arguments it reports the current binding and lists the repos available on this server.

repo.description: Name of a repo registered on this server. Omit to show the current binding and the available repos.

base_ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to check out from. Defaults to the repo's default branch.
